messages:
Riley: Heads-up: saw a sharp p99 blip on the latency endpoints pane for service=api-realtime between 03:10-03:18 UTC. p50/p95 are steady. Very focused on /v1/stream. Anyone else noticing a tail-only anomaly?
Sam: Which Console view/filters? Endpoints > Percentiles or the rollup view? Can you paste the query filter?
Riley: Endpoints > Percentiles, filter region=us-east, model=redwood-13b, endpoint=/v1/stream. Link: https://console/redwood/latency?endpoint=%2Fv1%2Fstream
Priya: Checked infra: a routing policy change rolled at 02:58 that reduced primary pool weight by ~10%. A handful of requests fell through to pool:legacy-hotfix.
Maya: Correlating logs: saw quota_exceeded events at 03:12 that caused fallbacks for tenant=big-retail. Log snippet: 
```
{"time":"2026-02-19T03:12:08Z","tenant":"big-retail","route":"api-realtime","decision":"fallback","reason":"quota_exceeded","target":"pool:legacy-hotfix"}
```
Sam: Important: how does Console compute p99? Do we merge tdigests from shards or stitch per-origin percentiles? The latter would be misleading for tails.
Priya: Backend merges tdigests and extracts percentiles (correct). But we hide sample_origin in the default UI, so the single-number p99 looks like a universal regression.
Riley: UX problem then. Users see a big p99 and assume platform regression even when it's an origin-specific tail.
Maya: Also sampling fractions are uneven. Some proxies sample 1/50; others 1/5. If the legacy pool briefly sampled more, the tail will be over-represented. We need to show sample_count.
Sam: Quick fixes proposal: 1) show sample_count inline near p50/p95/p99; 2) show top-2 contributing sample_origin badges in the hover (e.g., primary-pool: 94%, legacy-hotfix: 6%); 3) show a low-sample warning when sample_count < 100.
Priya: Mid-term: add a one-click partitioned query (percentiles grouped by sample_origin) so you can immediately see which origin drives the tail.
Maya: I can push a small UI patch for hover badges + sample_count + low-sample warning. ETA: today EOD. Will include the partitioned drilldown link.
ops-bot: route-policy-service v2.4.1 deployed by @deploy-bot at 2026-02-19T02:58:43Z (sha: c3d2b11) :rocket:
Riley: Thanks. Other ask: can we include sample_fraction metadata in the API so platform teams can verify sampling didn't bias the minute window?
Sam: I'll add a small telemetry endpoint to export sampling fractions per-origin for ad-hoc windows. Low-priority but useful for forensic.
Priya: Also recommend we add a short Console tooltip text: "Percentiles are computed from merged t-digests across telemetry shards. Drill down by sample_origin to attribute tails."
Maya: Adding that to the PR too.
Riley: Action items: Maya PR for tooltip+badges+drilldown+low-sample warning; Sam to add sampling-fraction endpoint; Priya to confirm routing weight delta and recommend temporary weight rollback if customer impact persists.
Sam: I'll run the sampling-fraction job for 03:05-03:20 and post raw counts.
Maya: PR link when ready: https://git/repo/pull/3482 (WIP).
Riley: Filing a short incident note for CS with root cause = routing weight change -> quota-induced fallback -> legacy pool tail; mitigation = surface origins + adjust weights.
Priya: Once PR lands, we'll monitor p99 for the next 6 hours and revert routing tweak if tail persists.
Riley: Thanks team. Closing after PR merge and verification. :thumbsup:
